sources.snippet: 3B Local Vision-Language Model for Seamless, Long-Horizon Document Parsing Unlimited-OCR is a 3B parameter multimodal vision-language model designed for end-to-end multi-page document processing in a single pass. Unlike traditional OCR tools that split documents page-by-page and lose thread/context, Unlimited-OCR retains full document context using a 32K token context window.

sources.snippet: Unlimited-OCR is a vision model from Baidu, released on 2026-06-22. It accepts text and image input and returns text output. The cataloged parameter count is 3.336B, with 500M active parameters per inference. The recorded context window is 32K, and the recorded maximum output is 32K. sources.snippet: Unlimited-OCR is a multimodal OCR and document-parsing model from Baidu, built for one-shot long-horizon document understanding. It reads images and pages and produces structured text output, extending the ideas behind DeepSeek-OCR toward parsing long documents in a single pass.
